request.description:
POST http://localhost:8080/auth/register

raw JSON:

{  
"email": "[test@gmail.com](https://mailto:test@gmail.com)",  
"password": "Test1234!",  
"name": "Test User",  
"phone": "70123456",  
"location": "BEIRUT",  
"accountType": "CUSTOMER"  
}

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **200 OK**
    
- Body: "User registered successfully"
    

**What happened?**

- User created in database
    
- OTP sent to email (check your test email inbox)
    
- User is NOT verified yet
    

**If it fails:**

- 409 Conflict → Email already exists (use different email)
    
- 400 Bad Request → Check JSON format

POST: http://localhost:8080/auth/verify-otp

raw JSON

replace CODE with actual OTP from email

{  
"email": "[test@gmail.com](https://mailto:test@gmail.com)",  
"code": "123456"  
}

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **200 OK**
    
- Body: "Email verified successfully"
    

**What happened?**

- User account is now ACTIVE
    
- Can now login
    

**If it fails:**

- 404 Not Found → Wrong email
    
- 400 Bad Request → Invalid/expired OTP
    

EndFragment

POST [http://localhost:8080/auth/login](http://localhost:8080/auth/login)

raw → JSON

{  
"email": "[test@gmail.com](https://mailto:test@gmail.com)",  
"password": "Test1234!"  
}

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **200 OK**
    
- Body:
    

{  
"token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiI1Iiwicm9sZSI6IkhZQlJJRF9QUk9WSUR...",  
"user": {  
"userId": 5,  
"email": "[test@gmail.com](https://mailto:test@gmail.com)",  
"name": "Test User",  
"phone": "70123456",  
"location": "BEIRUT",  
"accountType": "HYBRID_PROVIDER",  
"profilePhotoUrl": null,  
"simulatedBalance": 0.00,  
"isEmailVerified": true,  
"isActive": true,  
"isBanned": false,  
"createdAt": "2025-12-29T13:26:54.31978",  
"updatedAt": "2025-12-29T13:35:35.0093261",  
"lastLogin": "2025-12-29T13:35:35.0063244",  
"active": true,  
"emailVerified": true,  
"banned": false,  
"customer": false,  
"provider": true  
}  
}

**What happened?**

- Backend verified your credentials
    
- Generated a JWT token (valid for 7 days)
    
- Returned your user info
    

**If it fails:**

- 401 Unauthorized → Wrong password
    
- 403 Forbidden → Email not verified
    
- 404 Not Found → User doesn't exist
    

---

**Try to Login Before Email Verification**

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **403 Forbidden**
    
- Body: "Email not verified"
    

---

**Try to Login with Wrong Password**

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **401 Unauthorized**
    
- Body: "Invalid credentials"

GET [http://localhost:8080/auth/me](http://localhost:8080/auth/me)

Authorization -> Bearer Token -> **Paste the token**

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **200 OK**
    
- Body: Your user object (same as login response)
    

{  
"userId": 5,  
"email": "[test@gmail.com](https://mailto:test@gmail.com)",  
"name": "Test User",  
"phone": "70123456",  
"location": "BEIRUT",  
"accountType": "HYBRID_PROVIDER",  
"profilePhotoUrl": null,  
"simulatedBalance": 0.00,  
"isEmailVerified": true,  
"isActive": true,  
"isBanned": false,  
"createdAt": "2025-12-29T13:26:54.31978",  
"updatedAt": "2025-12-29T13:35:35.009326",  
"lastLogin": "2025-12-29T13:35:35.006324",  
"active": true,  
"emailVerified": true,  
"banned": false,  
"customer": false,  
"provider": true  
}

**What happened?**

- Backend verified your JWT token
    
- Extracted user info from token
    
- Returned your profile
    

**If it fails:**

- 401 Unauthorized → Token missing or invalid
    
- Make sure you selected "Bearer Token" in Authorization tab
    
- Make sure token is pasted correctly (no extra spaces)
    

---

**Try to Access /auth/me WITHOUT Token**

**Expected Response:**

- Status: **401 Unauthorized**
